purpose: Choose one memory head that can support the paper together with the already-qualified RS head, and repair candidate, label, realization, guard, and accountability as one system rather than tuning the failed V2 MS classifier.

paper_success_requirement.memory_only_failure_condition: RS passes but MP, MS, and ME all remain fixed OFF or show no end-to-end functional memory contribution.
paper_success_requirement.primary_end_to_end_evidence: The learned RS-plus-memory policy must be compared with always-off, fixed-high, transparent-rule, cost-matched fixed, and RS-only under the same retriever, projector, executor, generator, guard, and measurement stack.

head_priority.head: MS
why: V2 grouped OOF was borderline rather than collapsed: pooled BA 0.5993, AUC 0.6335, Brier better than prevalence.
In the frozen same-stack sample, predicted-ON states had 81.1% clean execution versus 54.8% for predicted-OFF states, a +26.2 point clustered-bootstrap enrichment.
Public longitudinal sessions directly support strictly-past continuity without requiring generated profiles or inferred action outcomes.
head_priority.current_failure: The author-ancestry gold and session-level Rank-1 do not identify whether the selected exact statement adds a useful, nonredundant contribution to the current reply.

head_priority.head: ME
why: Typed past action-result evidence has a clearer response function than free-form profile facts.
Past Step2 diagnostics showed that an eligible action-result can be converted into a declinable present option.
head_priority.current_failure: Only 417 source-annotated rows and 71 positives across 15 groups produced BA 0.3743 and recall 0.1127; action-readiness and exact intended Rank-1 coverage are not yet adequate.

head_priority.head: MP
why: Stable profile presence does not establish material response transformation.
The current public surface has no stable author gold for when a profile fact should change the reply.

same_stack_diagnosis.root_interpretation: The V2 MS head reduces bad executions relative to fixed-high, but it does not distinguish the seven truly functional memory states and its executor usually degrades response quality.

recurring_root_causes.evidence: A prior session can be an event ancestor while its selected exact turn is generic, redundant, stale, or irrelevant.
recurring_root_causes.repair: Gold is attached to the actual atomic Rank-1 evidence item, not to its parent session or event lineage.

recurring_root_causes.evidence: 53 of 68 ON arms made no distinct prior contribution even though all candidates passed structural retrieval.
recurring_root_causes.repair: Candidate eligibility explicitly measures semantic current-echo, use-mode relevance, specificity, owner/time safety, and a prospective material response change.

recurring_root_causes.evidence: V2 sends exact first-person user text to the generator, requires literal MS/ME mention, and rejects claimed use with no lexical word overlap.
recurring_root_causes.repair: Exact text remains the audit source, but the generator is instructed to synthesize and never copy it; lexical overlap is not evidence of function.

recurring_root_causes.evidence: Nineteen semantic guard failures were replaced by one generic M0 sentence; all 21 fallback ON replies lost the blind quality comparison.
recurring_root_causes.repair: Failure to use memory downgrades the realized bit to OFF while preserving a safe current-grounded reply; only genuine safety/ownership failures trigger a no-memory regeneration.

recurring_root_causes.evidence: The V2 contract forbids telling the generator every retrieved item must be used, but implementation still sets requires_literal_mention for every MS/ME item.
recurring_root_causes.repair: A machine invariant fails any executor that requires lexical memory mention, uses cross-component evidence union, or replaces safe non-use with a quality-poor fixed sentence.

MS_V3_candidate_and_gold.runtime_candidate: one strictly-past atomic seeker evidence item with source user, source session, source turn, exact quote, time relation, and active/conflict status
MS_V3_candidate_and_gold.candidate_discovery: split seeker turns into bounded atomic clauses; exclude phatic, meta-memory, incomplete-reference, and owner/time-invalid items before semantic ranking
MS_V3_candidate_and_gold.actual_rank1: highest frozen production score after structural eligibility; no query or candidate change after gold or outcome access
prospective_suitability_axes: DISTINCT_FROM_CURRENT: the meaning is not already present in the visible dialogue
IMMEDIATE_GOAL_RELEVANT: the specific old content can serve the current support goal, not merely share a topic
MATERIAL_USE_PLAN_EXISTS: an explicit use mode would change a question, interpretation, constraint, or option
OWNER_TIME_BOUNDARY_SAFE: it is the current user's past statement and is not silently upgraded to present truth
MS_V3_candidate_and_gold.gold: ON only when all four prospective axes are YES; otherwise OFF with one primary negative family
MS_V3_candidate_and_gold.label_source: source-aware researcher annotation with anchored examples; objective hard negatives are machine-derived, ambiguous semantic axes receive human review
MS_V3_candidate_and_gold.label_independence: event ancestry, future supporter text, summaries, observations, QA answers/evidence, response outcomes, generator traces, and PM features cannot determine gold

recognized_use_modes: continue an explicit unresolved question or plan
compare a prior coping action or constraint with a current update
avoid asking for a specific fact already supplied only in a past session
tentatively connect the same person/event when a new development changes the support goal
bounded_semantics.claim: bounded resource suitability, not unrestricted human semantic understanding

MS_V3_executor.model_visible_evidence: owner-tagged, past-tagged source quote plus a prospective use mode; the quote is context to reason over, not text to insert
generation_rules: Synthesize one coherent reply around the current user goal before considering the memory cue.
Never copy the first-person source quote or expose evidence IDs, components, fields, or scaffolds.
If the memory cue does not naturally improve the reply, omit it and report the MS bit as unrealized OFF.
If used, mark continuity tentatively and leave explicit room for change.
forbidden_implementation: positive lexical-overlap requirement between source quote and reply
verbatim user first-person content in the assistant voice
fixed generic quality fallback for safe memory non-use

postconditions.safe_nonuse: keep the generated current-grounded reply, set realized MS OFF, and count requested-versus-realized adherence separately
postconditions.owner_time_or_scaffold_violation: discard the contaminated reply and perform at most one frozen no-memory generation; count the extra call and cost
postconditions.transport_failure: use the same no-memory failure policy as all baselines
postconditions.function_measurement: source-aware offline judgment of contribution, MS function, and owner/time boundary; generator telemetry never establishes function

MS_V3_learning.model: low-capacity grouped classifier with probabilities; classifier family and feature schema freeze before semantic labels are read
features: frozen semantic relevance score and top1-top2 margin
stale/conflict/status indicators available strictly before the current response
MS_V3_learning.grouping: connected public user group; duplicated source conversations remain in one group
MS_V3_learning.evaluation: grouped OOF with BA, recall, specificity, ROC-AUC, Brier versus prevalence, calibration, ON/OFF fraction, and per-negative-family recall
MS_V3_learning.no_gate_chasing: No threshold or feature change is allowed after grouped OOF. Point estimates and owner-cluster intervals are reported; a single arbitrary BA cutoff is not the paper's success definition.
MS_V3_learning.pre_API_selection_rule: MS remains the chosen memory head only if grouped OOF improves both discrimination over chance/always-off and proper scoring over prevalence while retaining nontrivial ON and OFF predictions. If not, run the already-predeclared ME zero-API contingency rather than generator calls.

end_to_end_success_definition.policy_call_accuracy: agreement of requested MS ON/OFF with the prospective source-aware suitability gold on grouped OOF or an outer held-out surface
end_to_end_success_definition.executor_adherence: among requested ON, the fractions realized functional, safely downgraded OFF, safety-regenerated, and failed transport
end_to_end_success_definition.memory_value: the learned RS-plus-memory policy has positive meaningful-quality NetWin versus RS-only/always-off and produces verified functional memory contributions
end_to_end_success_definition.baseline_value: versus fixed-high and cost-matched fixed policies, learned routing reduces inappropriate memory calls, fallback/safety events, or cost without worse support quality
end_to_end_success_definition.risk: literal owner/time/scaffold events and independent absolute risk are reported separately from quality and function
end_to_end_success_definition.uncertainty: cluster by connected user; do not count sessions or state-action aliases as independent users
end_to_end_success_definition.claim_if_RS_plus_MS_or_ME_passes: paper objective met even if the other two memory heads remain fixed OFF and are reported as limitations

next_authorized_sequence_after_independe: Freeze an MS V3 atomic candidate and prospective suitability packet using all available public outer-train folds; no generator calls.
Complete anchored source-aware labels and run one grouped OOF; do not tune after results.
If MS satisfies the pre-API selection rule, freeze a small hand-confirmed eligible executor qualification and test synthesis/guard behavior without PM changes.
Only after both zero-API routing and executor qualification, run one new same-stack outer evaluation against RS-only, fixed-high, transparent-rule, and cost-matched baselines.
If MS fails before API, execute the frozen ME contingency; do not return to MP or generate longitudinal synthetic users.
